message.content:
The task was to check whether there are trade-in offers for the latest iPhone model.

The provided screenshot from Apple’s iPhone page shows an “Apple Trade In” card stating: “Save on a new iPhone with a trade-in” and offering “$175–$885 in credit toward iPhone Duo or iPhone 18 Pro when you trade in iPhone 13 or higher.” It also shows carrier trade-in deals offering up to $1200 in credit on a new iPhone after trade-in.

The result response accurately reports that Apple has trade-in offers and includes the trade-in credit range and carrier deal amounts shown in the screenshot. This satisfies the instruction to check whether such offers exist.

Verdict: SUCCESS
